critique_summary: The fleet is suffering from high cross-bot correlation in volatile assets like RENDER and ATOM, leading to synchronized drawdowns. While Oracle has correctly pivoted to a defensive SGOV position for the Bear regime, Kraken bots are over-exposed to high-beta assets with deteriorating win rates. Navigator's 12.5% win rate indicates a total failure of the current H4 swing logic in the present volatility regime.
critique_flags: Ineffective stop-loss on high-beta crypto pairs
